corpus.include: institution/**/*.md and docs/**/*.md, plus explicitly listed root files
corpus.exclusionRule: Only Markdown documents under the canonical corpus roots (institution/ for canonical institutional governance assets, docs/ for website-scoped implementation documentation) are governed corpus members, plus explicitly listed root-level operational instruction files. The workbench (workbench/) is structurally outside the corpus: it stages non-admitted working material that carries no institutional status (see workbench/README.md). Application source, configuration, and metadata/validation assets are technical artifacts, not corpus documents. This rescoping was executed by the Repository Foundation migration; the original docs-only rule is preserved in ADR-0001 as decision history.
